# Synthetic harness fixtures

Generated by `python -m agdash.devtools.fixture_kit` from the harness files of
one Linux machine. The structure of every record is kept; every prompt, reply,
thought, path, identifier, account and secret is replaced with synthetic
content, and every date is shifted by one fixed offset. Nothing here is real
session data.

Codex archives rollouts compressed. The kit also places a compressed copy of one
live rollout in `archived_sessions/`, so that one session appears both live and
archived.
